app.tagline: Speak. Your words appear wherever you type.

welcome.title: Your voice, typed anywhere.
welcome.subtitle: Hold a key, speak naturally, let go. Parler types your words in any app: email, chat, documents, code.
welcome.demo: Hi Camille, I'll send you the quote this afternoon. Talk soon!

provider.title: Who turns your voice into text?
provider.subtitle: Parler works with your own account at one of these services. You can switch at any time.

key.title: Connect {provider}
key.subtitle: An API key lets Parler use {provider} for you. It stays on this computer.
key.customSubtitle: Any server that speaks the OpenAI audio API works.
key.step1: Open the {provider} website and sign in
key.step3: Copy it and paste it below

permissions.title: Let Parler hear and type
permissions.subtitle: macOS asks once. Parler only listens while you hold the shortcut.
permissions.accessibilityHint: To type the text where your cursor is.

shortcut.title: Your dictation key
shortcut.subtitle: Hold it, speak, let go. A quick tap keeps listening until you tap again.

try.title: Your first dictation
try.idea1: Remind me to call the bakery tomorrow at nine.
try.idea2: Thanks for your message, I'll get back to you on Monday.
try.idea3: Add milk, eggs and coffee to the shopping list.
try.tip: Speak naturally: punctuation is added for you.

home.subtitle: Parler is ready in all your apps.

hint.smart: Let go to finish. A quick tap keeps listening until the next one.
hint.paste: The text is typed where your cursor is.
hint.copy: The text is copied to your clipboard.

home.emptyHint: Try it now, in any app.

vocabulary.title: Vocabulary
vocabulary.subtitle: Names, brands and jargon Parler should spell right. They're sent to the service as a hint.
vocabulary.placeholder: Add a word or a name…

problems.unknownProvider: Choose a service in the settings.
problems.missingApiKey: Add your {provider} API key to start dictating.
problems.missingBaseUrl: Enter your server's address in the settings.
problems.unauthorized: {provider} refused the API key. Check it in the settings.
problems.rateLimited: {provider} is limiting requests (rate limit or credit). Try again in a moment.
problems.needsAccessibility: Parler needs Accessibility access to type for you. Your text is on the clipboard: paste it with ⌘V.
problems.noClipboard: The clipboard isn't available on this system.
problems.pasteFailed: Pasting failed ({detail}). Your text is on the clipboard.
problems.shortcut: {shortcut} is already used by another app. Pick another shortcut.

transcription.title: Transcription
transcription.description: The service that turns your voice into text.
transcription.languageHint: Choosing your language makes transcription faster and more accurate.
transcription.modelHint: Pick one, or type any model the service offers.

shortcut.title: Shortcut
shortcut.description: How you start and stop a dictation.
shortcut.label: Dictation shortcut
shortcut.reserved: {shortcut} is an everyday shortcut (copy, paste, save…). Pick another one.
shortcut.smartHint: Hold to talk, or tap once to start and once more to stop.
shortcut.holdHint: Records for as long as you hold the shortcut.
shortcut.toggleHint: Press to start, press again to stop.
shortcut.wayland: On Wayland, global shortcuts are up to your desktop: bind one to the command {command}.

output.title: Text
output.description: What happens once your words are ready.
output.pasteHint: Typed where your cursor is; your clipboard is put back afterwards.
output.copyHint: Placed on the clipboard for you to paste.

general.title: General
general.soundsHint: A soft cue when listening starts and stops.
general.autostartHint: Parler waits quietly in the menu bar.

about.title: About
about.credits: Free and open source under the MIT licence. Microphone capture and parts of the desktop integration come from Handy.
